scope: Middle12 of ninth36 current HIGH masters actually compared across alpha pages4-6. All12 visibly lack original near-opaque backgrounds. Final12 are unreviewed at this point and no decision is inferred. Eligible middle segment is prepared independently without waiting for whole36 review.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Actually viewed exact original and current raw master on pages4-6 of immutable alpha comparisons: original full rectangular near-opaque painted background is missing from the returned figure cutout. Restore the exact full-canvas source painted backdrop, actual colour, texture, vignette, illumination and shadow. Keep opaque original interior; no new studio, frame, note or programmatic fill. Preserve all unrelated visible figure features and fitted short broad collar transition.
